lines.text: Many learners say: I need to make my homework.
Better: I need to do my homework.
Do! I always do my homework.

data.wrong: I need to make my homework.
data.right: I need to do my homework.

native.tip: Tarefa de casa é “do homework”. Em português usamos “fazer” para tudo.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “I need to make my homework.”. O certo é “I need to do my homework.”. Em inglês, “fazer” se divide em “make” e “do”. Ouça o Ama e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “do”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: Homework is “do homework”. In Portuguese we use “fazer” for everything.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “I need to make my homework.”. The right way is “I need to do my homework.”. In English, “fazer” splits into “make” and “do”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
